characters.name: An
characters.description: The stylized 3D young adult woman in the reference sheet, silver hair tied in a high ponytail, blue eyes, white shirt and turquoise earrings. Preserve her face, proportions, jewelry and outfit.

summary: A young woman notices someone she loves arriving, sits down, then smiles warmly toward them.

shots.description: Medium close-up in the cafe, CHAR_01 on the left looking right. She notices an arrival and slowly turns her head toward the cafe doorway. One clear movement, restrained anticipation. Static camera.
Medium shot in the same cafe. CHAR_01 sits down onto the chair in one quick natural motion. Her body remains proportionate; her hair follows with a small natural sway. Static camera.
Close-up of CHAR_01, looking toward the doorway on screen right, smiling softly with recognition. Her face is unobstructed. Gentle camera push-in.

sound: Quiet cafe ambience, chair movement. No dialogue and no music.
